Definition: Shekanjah, the name of nine Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shechaniah is the name of nine men, and the lists keep them straight by their sons and their courses. One is the father of Shemaiah in the royal line, one brings his sons to Ezra, and one stands among the priests in Nehemiah's list. The name means dwelling of Jehovah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the nine Shechaniahs show how God keeps a house full. One name, many men, each in his place, and I hold that the Lord dwells with all of them.
